verdict.rationale: Microsoft's marketing page says users can "easily configure fields, dashboards, and views," which directly touches custom fields and views. Nothing shows filtering, sorting, or sharing of views, or that a non-admin ops user can do this without an admin or Power Apps project. The Web API query features are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented filtering and sorting in user-built views, view sharing, evidence that non-admin users can add fields and views themselves, in-depth first-party docs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: Easily configure fields, dashboards, and views to match your organization’s sales methodology.
